blocks.content: A horseshoe-shaped belt around the Pacific Ocean marked by intense earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. Nearly 75% of the world’s active volcanoes occur here.
Nearly 75% of the world’s active volcanoes occur here.

items: Extremely common question: 75% of the world's active volcanoes are concentrated in this region around the Pacific Ocean.
Note the exact physical description often asked in exams: a 'horseshoe-shaped belt'.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The region forms a distinct horseshoe-shaped belt surrounding the Pacific Ocean.
It is characterized by frequent and intense seismic activity, including severe earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.
The belt hosts nearly 75% of all active volcanoes on the planet.
